notes.title: 🚀 Raiders Rise – Update v0.5 is here!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We’ve just pushed a new update with lots of improvements to the game experience, performance, and stability. Take a look at what’s new:



🌍 Better Connections & Gameplay
You can now choose your game region/server from the Settings menu. This helps improve connection and reduce lag.

Updated our core tech under the hood (Photon & Quantum) to keep things running fast.

All 5 current Raiders have received balance tweaks and polish to make combat feel even better:

🛡️ Jerar

Base HP: 750 → 700

Basic attack damage: 45 → 50

Primary ability hitbox adjusted (more accurate).

Bugfix: passive no longer activates twice.



⚡ Kathy

Movement speed: 4.8 → 5.0

Secondary ability damage: 90 → 80

Improved visual clarity on ultimate.

Bugfix: secondary now applies slow correctly.



🐲 Atabusk

Base HP: 1000 → 1100

Ultimate cooldown: 40s → 35s

New animation for ultimate.

Audio tweaks on heavy attacks.



🎯 Maya

Attack range: +0.5

Attack speed: 1.2 → 1.0

Optimized FX on secondary ability (better performance).

Bugfix: projectile no longer passes through small obstacles.



🔥 Jak

Basic attack damage: 60 → 55

Base HP: 650 → 700

Improved sound feedback for basic attacks.

Bugfix: ultimate no longer cancels accidentally.

   
🖥️ New & Updated Menus
Several screens have been freshly updated for clarity and style:


Add Friend, Enter Code

Character Selection

Reward & Post-Game screens

Settings

Pop-ups when you disconnect or quit


Icons across the game have been touched up for a cleaner look.



🐛 Bug Fixes & Polish
UI now scales correctly on different screen sizes and resolutions.

Fixed a bug causing enemies to get stuck in corners.

Small fixes across animations and character setups.

Jak’s dash issue when entering shop is now resolved! 

Jerar’s ultimate whilst dashing issue is fixed.

Ultimates showing earlier than expected due to poor connection is also resolved! 





Thanks so much for playing Raiders Rise and helping us improve along the way!
If you want to continue providing feedback or give V0.5 a go, hop onto our Discord where we host play sessions every Saturday 10pm CET!

notes.title: ⚙️ Raiders Rise Dev Update - More behind the scenes content!

Welcome back to another Raiders Rise dev update where we share what’s happening behind the scenes as we work toward release. Let’s jump in!


🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Player Experience Improvements
We’re making the Friends Flow smoother than ever! Changing your name and managing your friends list (adding or removing players) will soon be more intuitive.

We’re back with another update from Raiders Rise, and there’s a lot of exciting stuff to share. Let’s dive in!



🎯 Battle Pass & Missions Sneak Peak! 
Battle Pass Preview
 You might’ve noticed the Battle Pass tab in-game. We’ve updated it to clearly show that it’s still in progress so players don’t get confused or think it’s broken.

notes.title: 🚨 Raiders Rise Dev Update: New Features and More Art!
notes.notes:
We’re back with some exciting updates from the world of Raiders Rise. There’s a lot happening, so let’s dive right in!

⚙️Meta
The Raiders Collection screen is up and accessible from the top menu bar! Here, you’ll be able to browse all available Raiders. Selecting one takes you to their Cosmetics screen, where future skins and visual customizations will appear in the grey placeholder boxes.

The Progression tab will allow players to check out their skill tree and if you're curious about their backstory or abilities, the Raider Information button will take you straight to their character info screen.

Everything’s functional, though much of it is still placeholder, we’re excited to keep working on it! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/162a68e2861ebe61670f4a5582c46e504ac0bbaf.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/49d4171ef30c880736ebd2d76b26c803aacc3d7d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/27e7ba67edfc51763a69e046a5542540642abb98.png"]




💥Core
We’ve made solid progress on the ultimates for River and Snowbird! 

River, who normally relies on his gun for basic attacks, now switches things up in his ultimate where he’ll use his blade for a powerful close-range strike.

Snowbird’s passive skill is also in: he summons explosive clones that deal damage to monsters before detonating for extra impact. His ultimate creates a blue zone that slows enemies and gives himself an armor buff, making him much harder to take down.

And exciting news: Nikky is officially in development! You’ll get a sneak peek at some of his early movesets below! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/71eec95cd3c51ce485389f7226a69f8f896d601f.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5d4423d2064dda1ccab090425ffd3cbab8f0389c.gif"]



🧑‍🚀Characters 
As always, the art side has been packed!

We’ve been exploring visual directions for our newest Raider, Blayze. 

Big thanks to everyone who voted in the Zantetsu poll, we’ve locked in his final look. 

Our concept artists have also been cooking up fresh skins for Maya, Jerar, and Kathy, giving familiar faces some brand-new flair.

On the modeling front, both Sky and Atabusk’s models are now complete! Fun fact: the current in-game version of Atabusk will become a skin, while this new model will be his official base look going forward.

Enemies are getting some love too, we’ve updated the Mortar and Big Bee with new visual variations to bring more personality to the battlefield.

And over in animation, we’re wrapping up the final animations for Korin, Nikky, and River, with Sky’s rig now well underway.


Blayze Concept Exploration
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/02976c5c5b431ccb508c05f206b2eb749c7a175a.png"]

Zantetsu Concept

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/bcaa6e8d037cdbc0c9ae6343882c8643f3cb1d72.png"]
Jerar Skin Concept

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/7962f57d3b50f099cf6bfdf39e50a5ccb82eabe2.png"]

Atabusk Base Model

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/2917310f4e34c1697ae456cefe77250d2ac4442d.png"]

Sky Rig

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5d44f483e34c3b707f136294361ba1b0141a8aee.gif"]


🌍Environment
Last but not least, the Environments team has been hard at work expanding our desert biome, a once-submerged landscape now dried out and teeming with relics of the past.

We’ve added buried boats, sea creatures remains, weathered buildings, and market stalls to give the area a sense of depth.

We’ve also wrapped up polishing on the shop area, below you’ll see a closer look at some of the shop props. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/53011634495fb21ce3daa986b2b1120c1ffc19f6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/1277c9fe7f7f8c50691d581df523e80bc255e5ff.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d9fab477653845fbc0efa596bea2fea76a200b77.jpg"]
🎯That’s a wrap!
Thanks for joining us on another update! 

If you want to help shape this game while it’s still in development, don’t forget to wishlist Raiders Rise on Steam and join us on Discord for playsessions every Monday 5pm CET. 




See you next time!

notes.title: 🚨Raiders Rise Dev Update - Supercell Announcement & What’s New!
notes.notes:
We’re back with another exciting update and this one’s a big one. These past few weeks have been packed, both in and out of the game, and we’re thrilled to finally share what’s been going on.



🎉 Supercell TimeOut Tournament
We were honored to be invited to Supercell’s annual TimeOut event, where we held a live Raiders Rise tournament in Helsinki!

It was an incredible experience to connect with fellow developers, exchange stories about the wild ride that is game development, and feel part of a community that truly understands the journey.

And a personal highlight? Mike Morhaime - yes, The former CEO of Blizzard - played our game! 😱

Huge thanks to the team at Supercell for the invite and for putting together such a fantastic event. We're still buzzing!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d7698057509e2349a9c480c92e84ac2e1b639bcc.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/44eb76dc4ae244fc9b544258dcdc4e7c66b9ebec.jpg"]

But just because we hit this milestone doesn’t mean we’re slowing down - here’s what’s been cooking in development while the event was happening:


💥Core 
Snowbird & River are now in the testing phase, with ongoing balancing and visual implementation.

The Wall and Maze levels are also now in testing - visuals are shaping up nicely.

Our design team is hard at work drafting documentation for Characters 11 to 20! These are now in review and will be iterated on in the upcoming weeks.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/b36cbfb72bd6ad5111e36d19161a6ba768cd7ecb.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/a6f928f309a716a3d37744d17233d7ade00fa644.png"]


🧑‍🚀Characters
Our character team continues to push forward with new additions and refinements:

Finalized concept for Character 10: Sky

First concept art drafts for Character 11: Zantetsu

New base concepts for both Atabusk and Maya

Modeling is now complete for Snowbird

Big Bee enemy variants

Animation progress for River and Nikky

Ongoing animation iteration for Korin, we’re still trying to get a feel for this character’s movement.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/69785a52d9a2060e2e992bf998caf44af4a26341.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/2b992b20d71ecbe21ca25a51fbbd8bec7e268ad0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/e09966b685d565a80ee752f50a3860b95f049354.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/a30d8645a5d8a7c0043f97dd234eff490f5dbacc.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/7fa7933cf99766cab66ae91310747af37b8df81a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/95630ee9308e5a40117ad8386fa72fd4309f9065.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/1efbe9a2f378ecb6be4b69ab2efb5ab41bb5c491.gif"]


🌍Environments
Things are shaping up beautifully on the environment front:

The Wall and Maze levels are now ready for internal review and they’re looking great!

We’ve revisited the Shop Level so now the shop screens match our vending machines dotted around the levels! 

Exploration has started on our next biome which will be desert themed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/2e00b6e9f19be56a5a05084ec4a300b8a46f72a1.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d106624d3017a0d7f7c10b6c0511f1e475690461.png"]


🎬That’s a Wrap!
Thanks for following along on our development journey - it means the world to us.

Seeing Raiders Rise up on the big screen in Helsinki was a surreal moment that made these past few weeks unforgettable. We couldn’t have gotten here without the incredible efforts of our team - and you, our community.




 Want to help shape the future of a Supercell-backed indie game?

➡️ Wishlist Raiders Rise on Steam

➡️ Join our Discord to playtest and share your thoughts




Until next time,

- The Raiders Rise Team

notes.title: 🚨 Sprint 7 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Welcome back to another Raiders Rise dev update - and a big thanks to all of you following our development journey. We’ve got a packed one this sprint, so let’s dive right in:




⚙️ Meta

Top Menu Bar Rework - Now fully gamepad-ready for smoother navigation.

Battle Pass & Missions - Work continues on these progression systems.

Lobby, Friends & Matchmaking UX - We’ve been squashing bugs and making steady improvements to ensure everything feels intuitive and responsive.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d9e0038385d32b779a2798c4da3da4c0232dc2ec.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/cea2ac71f23fa1b20b00f74bdc1bb7cfe28c8cf8.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/03c4676efa2ad9e943311bc4c1b54fc13e1b2d02.png"]

💥 Core Gameplay

Big steps forward with our next two playable characters: Snowbird and River!

Snowbird

Basic - Snowbird basic attack is implemented and feels great!

Ultimate - His ultimate slows nearby enemies and grants a personal shield.

Skill - Snowbird creates ice clones to confuse and distract enemies - perfect for sneaking past them! 

River

Basic - Implemented, with a twist: his last bullet bounces around the level before reloading!

Ultimate - Placeholder implemented, when we do the final pass you’ll see he equips his sword when the ultimate is activated. 

Level Expansion

Early versions of Level 1 for both Planet 2 and Planet 3 are now roughed out and ready for internal testing. The world is expanding!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/86c56851d88e67de3bddf1825ce115684fe7c8b0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/b29007527203ebd838b7621ef349f2a1142d91bc.png"]


🧑‍🚀 Characters 

The character team has been hard at work this sprint:

Snowbird and River - models are nearly complete and ready for integration.

Korin - a melee-centric character, is getting special treatment with new workflow tests to support his unique combat style.

Nikky - To speed things up without sacrificing quality, we’re transferring base animations from River to Nikky.

River -  VFX moodboarding is underway, giving us a glimpse at the visual direction Alex is taking.

Sky - our 10th character is in early concepting!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/7fa7933cf99766cab66ae91310747af37b8df81a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/ac2fdc53ef6216f9faa2e873363e0e137aaad0cd.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/ea63f13c8627530393d1001532ce8922a25b5eb4.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5a983c74142b34d6511f544f7a4e5620189963d5.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/fee2aeeed3332359da7c96c8c9b580562af3e40b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/c03aca200b37c99179ea61c37f522b96cf032fe7.png"]




🌍 Environment Art

Wall & Maze Levels - The last two levels of planet 1 are almost ready for internal testing! 

Planet 1 Polishing - Level polish continues across the board, helping bring a more lived-in, reactive feel to each environment.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/e7aa2fb08c05d1d3ca0b9eabd4c40b033405d3fb.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/b499a0f6f19d5a251cc82e4050f9be5706f358f3.png"]
🎯That’s a Wrap!

Thanks for checking out our latest sprint update! Your support, feedback, and playtesting means the world to us as it’s shaping Raiders Rise into something truly special.

If you haven’t already:
 ➡️ Wishlist Raiders Rise on Steam
 ➡️ Follow us for future updates
 ➡️ Join our Discord to playtest and share your feedback!



Until next time! 
- The Raiders Rise Team

notes.title: 🚨 Sprint 6 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Welcome back to another Raiders Rise dev update and this one’s a big one.

We’re thrilled to announce that we hit our milestone for Build 0.3! A massive shoutout to the entire team for the incredible push to make it happen. Let’s jump into what’s new:






⚙️ Meta
Lobby Finalized – The new lobby layout is in and locked (for now).

Friends System Improved – Friends are now grouped into Online and Offline for clearer visibility.

Matchmaking Debug Tools – Backend updates allow us to fix matchmaking issues during play sessions.

Fight Flow UI – Our combat flow now has sleek new UI mockups!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5a7663fbf679eb0b8d434fe1a3becbf3fedac901.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/e0bd0881b930aac406e8e5b0534087ee4ffa95c2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/c2d7c2b3d11203e04abdd0cf1f591d9972bb73f1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/860bc7ea0acedd305835bd5891d7dddd2c0cc4e3.png"]


💥 Core Gameplay
Health Bar Update – Health bars now clearly show how your HP stacks up against others.

Skill Icons & Cooldowns – Passive abilities now show cooldowns, plus we’ve refreshed passive icons and skill upgrade headers.

Re-Deploy Damage – You can now damage enemies on landing when re-deploying.

In-Game Emojis – New emoji set was added! We’ve trimmed down the slots to reduce visual clutter and streamline usage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/6e8460e9a605c8890d8c23c863419dbd53356bb9.png"]




🧑‍🚀 Characters & VFX
Character Portraits – Full-body portraits and icons for our first 5 characters have been added to the game.

Concept Art – We made progress on the adorable (and dangerous) Summoner enemy, and supported icon work for consumables.

3D Art – Jak’s model is shaping up nicely, and Nikky’s blockout is already in the works!

Animations – Jak is fully animated and milestone-ready! Plus, mining animations got a polish pass across several characters.

VFX Update – Say hello to the explosive Kamikaze enemy. You’ll know them when you see them.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/7ccc2b0bc61ef586372819a31682ec60718e4f4c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/e29692aaed19289e37366c56017248ebf7878c5c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/72c21ea93a2d1c80fa8ac8d87d457e12b94c01d8.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5da67627e6f88bc46b41217b73193cde0500ea54.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/13adc87d435605347ac07277acaf9d9a2cf272b2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/ae7b52e54e8193adb6017593c18c35ee92bdf08e.gif"]


🌍 Environments
All milestone levels are now in-game! Here are some standout improvements:

Bus elements

Sliding & drop-down doors

Vending machines (yes, they have sad faces when you can’t interact and happy ones when you can - our favorite detail!)

Crates galore – regular, military, destructible, energy

Exterior of the shop

 Crystals

Our world’s coming to life in big ways, and these environmental updates make each match feel that much richer.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/f6a5fae6e48a61221c3df59587e95c7bcf35d58f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/21b3a88a7317f4e9074cbd97ae883020443f0863.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/1bf3b9899b0c15fb2b034b253a8e10a29df75da7.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/c1329a1cbddb88dc224a76fd3a40b8a36b7eac7e.gif"]
🎯 That’s a Wrap!


Thanks for reading and for being part of this journey. If you’re enjoying the ride so far, don’t forget to:

➡️ Wishlist Raiders Rise

➡️ Follow us for more updates

➡️ Join the playsessions in our Discord!



More fun, chaos, and surprises are on the way. See you in the arena!



– The Raiders Rise Team

notes.title: 🚀 Sprint 4 Update
notes.notes:
Raiders Rise – Sprint 4 Dev Update

Hi everyone, welcome back to another sprint update for Raiders Rise! Every two weeks we share our progress, and this sprint was packed with big steps across systems, characters, and levels. Let’s dive into the highlights:

[hr][/hr]

🧠 Meta & Core Systems


Mission Progression Revamp
Backend and frontend improvements made to mission progression, plus internal testing of the Battle Pass prototype.

Reconnection System
First version is in! If a player disconnects, a bot temporarily takes control until they return - making matches smoother even with connection drops.

Victory Screen Iteration
A working version is in place, but we’re still figuring out how to properly display characters and their skins without visual overlap. One proposed fix is cropping each character's screen space to avoid clutter.

Duo Chests
These new chests require two players to open - either teammates or opponents. Strategic and cooperative!

Expanded Emotes


9 total slots: 5 for team, 4 for public emotes
Fully functional with controllers
Cancel input added
(Control scheme still being polished)



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/8fbd8bee2f99b8483739fe2229c4bddbb451a713.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/86f4c4443b4bc37292b1c70df1e199fbeebe800c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/e4db4d4ec5ff03dc55e37ab39d2cbc346e7db827.png

[hr][/hr]

🧑‍🚀 Characters & Creatures


Jak
Receiving new weapon options, including a shotgun. Her updated model is in blockout and uses a liquid shader for more dynamic visuals.

Nikky
Our new electric trap specialist is in early development. Their gameplay is focused on area control and surprise traps.

Maya
Preliminary model and weapon are finalized and looking slick. Animation improvements are also underway.

Bee Enemies
We’ve created three evolution stages for this new enemy type - they’re deadly and cute.

Animation Work

Final tweaks for Atabusk
Character-specific polish for Jerar and Maya



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/02878895a189a971e2ec6038e7f1bdcfd56f3128.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/801873b989a12bd96e4f3ce5ecac039d1d55b49e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/ead0b4f8eb2e659d1af40ac271916715934ee917.png

[hr][/hr]

🌍 Levels, Props & Biomes


Planet 1 - Level 2
Playable. We’re working on signs, city props, and biome 2 assets.

Destructible Elements
We prototyped breakable barriers, tested in a sandbox scenario. Players will soon get some nice visual feedback on these destructable elements!

New Door Mechanics
Multiple door types in testing - including drop-down doors with improved clarity and performance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/efab786ff03e7ba86236102fb2e16336eb8f8423.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/4b9d98804b6f3a67bc1588c352d12c3e301013a7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/f32bd898e1ee8077af3169dbd0d7a2845211f6ec.png

[hr][/hr]

🧪 Playtests & Community

Weekly playtests happen every Monday at 17:00 CET – open to everyone via our Discord!
Come test the latest builds, give feedback, and help us shape the game together.

📅 Join us → Discord Invite
🎮 Wishlist the game → Steam Page

[hr][/hr]

💬 Final Words

That’s it for Sprint 4! Massive shoutout to the team for the amazing work across all departments - from gameplay systems and character design to animation and level art.
We’ll be back in two weeks with even more.

Thanks for following us on this journey. 💜

notes.title: Raiders Rise – Sprint Update #3
notes.notes:
🚦 Sprint Status  
  
✅ Green: Objectives met  
❌ Red: Delayed tasks — Not to point fingers, just to detect risks and prioritize next steps.  


🚨 Next Big Milestone: Tournament Showcase  
📅 June 10 – Private event with a Raiders Rise tournament  
  
~150 players including developers and investors  
Huge opportunity to secure long-term support (and possibly funding!)  
We must deliver a stable, polished, and impressive version  
  
👉 Key goal: no crashes, no broken animations, no matchmaking bugs. Let’s go for the wow factor.

🧼 Polishing Initiative  
We’re officially dedicating up to 20% of the sprint (1–2 days per person) to improve:  
  
Art  
Code  
Design  
Gameplay feel  
  
🛠 This will be planned per person based on feedback gathered before each sprint.

🔁 New Feedback Workflow for VFX and Animation  
  
Pull Requests will now include early feedback from Elias and Damien  
Goal: detect changes or issues before merging  
Better alignment with style and quality from the start  


🧪 Playtesting and UX Improvements  
  
Improved feedback for connection errors  
Visible connection status and game version in the UI  
"Join match" button hidden if no match is active  
Ongoing internal testing and bug fixing (20% of sprint)

notes.title: Raiders Rise – Sprint Update #2
notes.notes:
🎮 Core Features & Systems✅ Battle Pass Fully Integrated
The Battle Pass UI is up and running! Players can now:
  View milestones  Track progression  Claim rewardsAll fully connected to our backend systems via Metaplay.
Next sprint, we'll finalize the AT2 and polish the experience even further.

🧪 Major Stabilization & Versioning Pass
We've spent a good chunk of this sprint making sure the Quantum version of the game is stable and ready for external playtests. Here’s how:
  We created a dedicated release branch (v0.1) for bug fixing only—no new features, no distractions.  Meanwhile, all ongoing feature work continues in main, including new characters, animations, and VFX.This setup lets us iterate fast without breaking everything. Expect more clean versions like this in the future!


🧝‍♂️ Characters & Animation✨ New Characters Incoming!
  
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/235c14440fd939a5552b51b81e630b45f0c80bbe.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/9e2d70cb4da5880fbb8ccae78a87b578d6e9e77d.png"]Korin is in progress and already in blocking stage.  A brand-new tank is in the works, inspired by the iconic albino gorilla from Barcelona Zoo (yes, really).[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/c7f419cdd062e176cc4773b8aeecd799b42929a8.png"]Atabusk is fully modeled and now animated with a strong, aggressive idle pose. 


🐧 The Penguin is Alive!
The Penguin character is now fully animated with:
  Idle, attack, jump, and movement loops[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/8e865d0757a4326c7ea93a3657580c5492a88832.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/78c661445dfdce4faa08101efd210d6e9b0167e2.gif"]Plus a hilarious inflate-and-pop ultimate in the works.
It’s one of our most expressive characters so far!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/9367afc65efec9042ef52a3cf7ecab153fab6e07.gif"]
💥 VFX & Combat Polish
Maya’s attack and ultimate animations are looking slick with some flashy new VFX from Alex. We're pushing for every character to feel distinct and powerful in battle.


🏜 Environment & Tools🌵 Desert Biome Progress
We’re working hard to lock down the visual style of the desert biome. Highlights:
  Unique materials tied to the desert’s lore[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/13c672f9f0658f4ec0f05869e5aff169ea012124.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/0a34b77764c8a302d581b7d8a84d048f4e282036.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/0a8b797d5f53e2ef49de9bcb6b18a3d742d54cc3.png"] Level dressing tools to speed up iteration  Deeper, more layered layout designs

We’re also exploring how in-world signage and ads can tell stories and build immersion. These aren't just decoration—they tie into the lore and factions.

notes.title: Raiders Rise Update!
notes.notes:
📢 Game Development Updates

🎯 Missions System (Work in Progress!)
One of the biggest new features we started integrating is the Missions System. The goal is to track in-game achievements, like collecting resources or completing certain challenges.  
Right now, we’re setting up the backend so that the game correctly registers and saves progress.  
This is a major step toward adding more structured gameplay goals and keeping things engaging for players.

🛍️ UI Overhaul & Store Improvements
The UI team made great progress in reworking the in-game store.  
We’re moving toward a cleaner, more intuitive layout, making it easier for players to browse, purchase, and customize their raiders.  

A new upgrade system design was also introduced, where upgrades are now represented as “chips.”  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5ce67d209b70cf6c8bccdb4e37224912ca68932f.jpg  
This makes the system more thematic and visually appealing, while also making it easier for players to understand.  
We’re even toying with fun ways players might refer to it—like calling it the chip shop!

🕹️ Gameplay & Feature Updates
Scaling Adjustments:  
We fixed a lot of proportional issues in the game world, so objects, characters, and UI elements are more consistent in size and readability.

New Cosmetics & Customization Menus:  
A first version of the character customization system is ready!  
Players will be able to change skins, emotes, and more.

Emojis System:  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/dc82089dd11a9fbd80e00b752a1e5960f819d42c.jpg  
We’ve started implementing an emoji communication system for players to use in-game.  
These emojis can be:

Text-based  
Animated  
Include sound effects  
  
(Yes, the poop emoji does have a sound effect. Priorities.)

🧙 Character & Art Updates
New Characters in Production:  
Character design has been on fire this sprint!  
Several new characters are at different stages of development:


River design is approved!  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/495f40f30939a4775be0c06b2cde5c884deee368.jpg

A powerful old-lady healer is in progress—she’s not just wise, she’s a healer.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d6341ca4b2059544b9c62e0684175a9426bd8deb.png

Atabusk hi poly model is finally finished!  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/eb58d6b076c27c88d142b0fdc093f1dda3bc76fe.jpg


New hi poly models, rigs and animations are coming in fast, making the roster more diverse and exciting.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/ded49eace26ada32a0d5da301ac96bc5714df823.png  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/3b7b568a7d0ef1e60695a6eff6ea76049f0f0ed7.gif  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/00ad1bfacb4b78da9e6ada0e2d581416c0810ce9.gif

🌵 Environment & Visual Enhancements
The art team has been fine-tuning the environmental design to create a more distinct visual identity for the game.  
Some key updates include:


A new shading technique that adds a subtle texture to objects, making everything feel more hand-painted instead of flat.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5a2e5186272aa02f9e713ddbc69fe98ed881d915.gif

Improvements to desert environments, helping us define the final visual style of the game’s world.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/60ad856fdde781dc760858ae7cedcb3a1838f214.png

Level design sketches are being finalized, giving clearer direction for upcoming environments.
